words.def: the main, underlying reason a problem happens.
words.book: I try to understand the root cause of the problem and identify all the potential options for resolving it.
uses: Email
Our engineer has identified the root cause of the repeated UPS shutdowns: a faulty bypass switch.
Chat
did we find the root cause or just reset it again? 🤔
Meeting
Before we replace anything, let's agree on the root cause.
dont: We need to know the reason of the reason.
doo: We need to find the root cause.

words.def: people or groups who are affected by or involved in a project or decision.
words.book: I also consult with my team or other stakeholders to gather different perspectives and insights.
uses: Email
I will share the project timeline with all stakeholders, including the client's facility manager.
Chat
need sign-off from all stakeholders before we order the batteries
Meeting
Who are the key stakeholders on the hospital solar project?
dont: All the people who have relation with the project.

words.ar: في الوقت المناسب / من غير تأخير
words.def: quickly and at the right time, without delay.
words.book: To overcome these challenges, I implemented a clear project plan and communication strategy, and I also made sure to regularly check in with all team members to ensure everyone was on the same page and that any issues were addressed in a timely manner.
uses: Email
We kindly ask that outstanding invoices be settled in a timely manner.
Chat
pls reply to the client in a timely manner, they're chasing us
Meeting
Service requests must be handled in a timely manner to protect our SLA.
dont: Please pay in the suitable time.
doo: Please pay in a timely manner.

words.def: points or interests that two sides agree on or share.
words.book: Then I try to find common ground and identify areas of agreement.
uses: Email
I'm confident we can find common ground on the payment terms.
Chat
let's find some common ground with purchasing before the call
Meeting
We didn't agree on price, but we found common ground on the warranty.
dont: We need to find a middle point.
doo: We need to find common ground.

words.book: It ended up being a win-win situation, and the project was a success.
uses: Email
An extended maintenance contract would be a win-win: lower costs for you and guaranteed response times.
Chat
sounds like a win-win to me 🤝
Meeting
We're looking for a win-win deal with the distributor.
dont: Both of us will be benefited.

words.def: to watch something carefully so you notice any changes or problems.
words.book: In addition, I always take the time to stay informed about my competitors, keeping an eye on their product releases, marketing strategies and customer feedback, to know what they're doing and how they are performing.
uses: Email
We will keep an eye on the battery temperature after the replacement and report back.
Chat
keep an eye on that overdue account pls 👀
Meeting
Let's keep an eye on competitor pricing for solar inverters this quarter.
goes: keep an eye on the competition
dont: I will put my eye on the site.
doo: I'll keep an eye on the site.

upgrade.plain: I heard about you many good things.
pro: I've heard great things about your work.
I heard about you many good things.
I listened good things about you.

upgrade.plain: I started small and I grew up in the company until I became manager.
upgrade.ar: بدأت صغير وكبرت في الشركة لحد ما بقيت مدير
pro: I grew up in the company until manager.
I worked my way up to my current role.
I raised in the company step by step.
upgrade.why: ‎work my way up‎ = اترقيت خطوة بخطوة؛ ‎grew up‎ يعني كبرت في السن.

upgrade.plain: The project affected on the profit of the company very much.
upgrade.ar: المشروع أثّر على أرباح الشركة جامد
pro: The project affected on the company profit.
The project made big effect in the profit.
The project had a significant impact on the company's bottom line.
upgrade.why: ‎affect‎ من غير ‎on‎، و‎bottom line‎ = صافي الربح.

upgrade.plain: The project was very complicated and has many things.
upgrade.ar: المشروع كان معقد وفيه حاجات كتير
pro: It was a complex project with many moving parts.
The project was very complicated and many things.
The project had a lot of details things.
upgrade.why: ‎many moving parts‎ = أجزاء كتير لازم تتنسق مع بعض.

upgrade.plain: I want to say again I am very excited for the job.
upgrade.ar: عايز أقول تاني إني متحمس جدًا للوظيفة
pro: I want to say again I am excited on the job.
I'd like to reiterate my enthusiasm for the role.
I repeat that I am very excited.
upgrade.why: ‎reiterate‎ = أكرر بشكل رسمي في آخر المقابلة.

upgrade.plain: I made my team pass the target.
pro: I made my team to pass the target.
My team passed the target by me.
I led my team to exceed sales targets.
upgrade.why: ‎led my team to exceed‎ بتبين قيادتك، و‎exceed‎ أحسن من ‎pass‎.
